blocks.text:
When a drop target has accepted a dragged item, certain signals will be
emitted, depending on what action has been selected. For instance, the user
might have held down the Shift key to specify a
`move` rather than a `copy`. Remember that
the user can only select the actions which you have specified in your calls to
Gtk::DragSource::set_actions() and
Gtk::DropTarget::set_actions().
blocks.zh: 当放置目标接受了被拖动的项，会根据所选择的动作发出特定的信号。例如，用户可能按住了 Shift 键，指定进行 `move` 而不是 `copy`。请注意，用户只能选择你在调用 Gtk::DragSource::set_actions() 和 Gtk::DropTarget::set_actions() 时所指定的动作。

blocks.text: The source widget will emit these `DragSource` signals:
blocks.zh: 源部件会发出这些 `DragSource` 信号：

blocks.text:
`prepare`: Shall return a `Gdk::ContentProvider`,
  with the data to use for the drag that is about to start.
blocks.zh: `prepare`：必须返回一个 `Gdk::ContentProvider`，其中是即将开始的拖拽所要使用的数据。

blocks.text:
`drag_end`: Provides a `Gdk::Drag`,
  and a `bool` that tells if the drag was performing a `move`
  and the data should be deleted.
blocks.zh: `drag_end`：提供一个 `Gdk::Drag`，以及一个 `bool`，表示这次拖拽是否是 `move`、数据是否应当删除。

blocks.text: `drag_cancel`: Emitted on the drag source when a drag has failed.
blocks.zh: `drag_cancel`：在拖拽失败时，在拖拽源上发出。

blocks.text:
`enter`: Provides coordinates.
  Shall return the preferred `Gdk::DragAction`.

`motion`: Provides coordinates.
  Shall return the preferred `Gdk::DragAction`.

`leave`: Emitted on the drop site when the pointer
  leaves the widget.
blocks.zh: `leave`：在指针离开部件时，在放置位置上发出。

blocks.text:
`accept`: Provides a `Gdk::Drop`.
  You can call the status() method of the
  `Gdk::Drop` to indicate which actions will be accepted.
blocks.zh: `accept`：提供一个 `Gdk::Drop`。你可以调用 `Gdk::Drop` 的 status() 方法来指示将接受哪些动作。

blocks.text:
`drop`: Provides the data being dropped and coordinates.
  Shall return a `bool` indicating whether the drop was accepted.
blocks.zh: `drop`：提供被放下的数据和坐标。必须返回一个 `bool`，指明是否接受了这次放置。
